title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
statement: Given a binary tree as a level-order list `root` (with `null` for missing children), return a list of lists: each inner list is one level from left to right, starting at the root level.

predict_steps.prompt: After processing the root level [3], which nodes are in the next queue?
What values appear on the third level of the demo?

viva.question: Why is BFS level order O(n)?
What does an empty tree return?
Why snapshot the queue size at the start of a level?
expected_points: know how many nodes belong to this level
